title: Diwali — Festival of Lights
message: May your life be filled with light, happiness, prosperity and new opportunities. Wishing you and your family a very Happy Diwali!

title: Holi — Festival of Colours
message: May the colours of Holi bring joy, peace, good health and success into your life. Have a safe and wonderful Holi!

title: Eid Mubarak
message: May this Eid bring peace, happiness, good health and prosperity to you and your loved ones. Eid Mubarak!

title: Raksha Bandhan
message: Celebrating the special bond of love, care and protection between brothers and sisters. Happy Raksha Bandhan!

title: Happy New Year
message: Wishing you a year filled with fresh beginnings, meaningful progress, happiness and success. Happy New Year!
